text: Fixed. The bug was in `update_fee` in `app/routers/fees.py`. When `amount` or `product_amount` changed on an unpaid fee, `balance_amount` wasn't updated, so it kept the old value (125 instead of 175). The patch records the old total before the update. If the update doesn't set `balance_amount` explicitly and the fee isn't paid, it shifts the balance by the change in the total, floored at 0. This keeps any partial payment intact. Tool results show the target test passing (1 passed) and the full `tests/` directory passing (30 passed). I only changed `app/routers/fees.py`.
